title: Honorary titles of Ukraine
text:
ion of Ukraine, there was introduced the Soviet-type award granted to cities, defenders of which distinguished themselves in fight against military aggression. Previously in the Soviet Union a similar award was granted to cities in the aftermath of World War II.

Hero of Ukraine, successor of the Hero of the Soviet Union and the Hero of Socialist Labor

Mother-Heroine, successor of the Mother-Heroine of the Soviet Union

Hero City of Ukraine, successor of the Hero City (Soviet Union)

People's Artist of Ukraine

People's Architect of Ukraine

People's Teacher of Ukraine

People's Painter of Ukraine

These titles have also been translated as "Honored" rather than "Merited". However, since Order of Merit is awarded for highest merits (Ukrainian: заслуги, zasluhy), honorary titles are translated as Merited (Ukrainian: заслужений, zasluzhenyi).
